title: Create a Student class
instruction: Create a `Student` class with `__init__` that takes `name` and `grade`. Add an `introduce()` method that returns `"Hi, I'm [name] and I'm in grade [grade]."`
starter_code:
class Student:
    # Your code here
    pass

# Test it
s = Student("Alice", 10)
print(s.introduce())

test_cases.expected_output: Hi, I'm Alice and I'm in grade 10.

title: Add __str__ to Student
instruction: Add a `__str__` method to your `Student` class so that `print(student)` displays `"Student: [name], Grade: [grade]"`.
starter_code:
class Student:
    def __init__(self, name, grade):
        self.name = name
        self.grade = grade

    # Add __str__ method here

# Test it
s = Student("Bob", 11)
print(s)

title: Inherit from Student
instruction: Create a `GraduateStudent` class that inherits from `Student`. Add a `thesis_topic` attribute to `__init__` and override `introduce()` to include the thesis topic.

test_cases.expected_output: Hi, I'm Diana, grade 12. My thesis is on AI in Healthcare.
